locations.heading: Storage locations
locations.description: Places Elysium saves files to, each with an optional limit on how much Elysium stores there. Passwords are encrypted and never shown again after saving.

page.notFound: This storage location does not exist. It may have been deleted.

table.label: Storage locations
table.name: Name
table.empty: No storage locations yet. Add one to choose where Elysium saves files.
table.loadError: Storage locations could not be loaded.

form.name: Name
form.zoneHint: The zone's name, as shown at the top of its page in Bunny's dashboard.
form.regionHint: Shown under Storage Zone Region Endpoint in Bunny's dashboard.
form.pathPrefixHint: Optional. Elysium saves files under this directory in the zone; leave blank for the zone's root.
form.projectsHint: The projects that save files here. * picks every project, including ones added later.
form.noLimitHint: Elysium stores as much here as the provider allows.
form.storageLimitHint: The most Elysium stores here, in gigabytes.
form.accessKeyHint: The zone's Password from Access in Bunny's dashboard. Not the Read-only password, since Elysium writes files.
form.accessKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep the current password.

errors.nameTaken: Another storage location already uses this name.
errors.zoneInvalid: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits, or hyphens.
errors.pathPrefixInvalid: Use directory names separated by single slashes, without . or .. or backslashes.
errors.storageLimitInvalid: Enter a limit greater than zero.
errors.accessKeyTooLong: Passwords can be at most 1 KB.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Elysium stops saving files here. Files it already saved stay in the storage zone; delete them from Bunny's dashboard if you no longer need them.

toasts.testPassed_one: {{name}} is reachable: {{count}} item in its directory
toasts.testPassed_other: {{name}} is reachable: {{count}} items in its directory

setup.title: Find the zone's details
setup.description: Check off each step as you go.

bunny.open: Open Storage in the bunny.net dashboard, then open the zone to use, or add one.
bunny.zone: Copy the zone's name, shown at the top of its menu, into Storage zone.
bunny.access: Open Access, on the API / HTTP tab.
bunny.region: Choose the region shown under Storage Zone Region Endpoint, such as London, UK.
bunny.password: Under Access Key, reveal and copy Password into Password. Not the Read-only password: Elysium writes files.
